comment: The application -> CSS contract of the custom accent, the mirror image of runtime-contract.json's JS -> CSS one: an application writes ONE colour into --dx-accent-color and scss/widgets/fluent-next/_accent-color.scss derives the whole primary scale from it with relative colour syntax. These names are not part of the component tier - `accent` is neither a component nor a registered system concern - and fluent-next is the only theme that derives a palette, so tests/fluent-next-naming.test.ts excludes them from the public-surface checks. tests/accent-palette.test.ts holds the stylesheet, the generated palettes and the built bundles to this file.

input.name: --dx-accent-color
input.setBy: the application, on the root element
input.whenUnset: every derived step is invalid at computed-value time, so each generated palette keeps the designed colour through var(--dx-accent-color-<step>, <designed value>)

source.name: --dx-accent-color-source
source.purpose: the single read of the application's name, so the 18 step expressions do not each carry it

settings.name: --dx-accent-lightness-max
settings.purpose: the lightness the light end of the scale arrives at

settings.name: --dx-accent-lightness-min
settings.purpose: the lightness the dark end of the scale arrives at

settings.name: --dx-accent-chroma-min
settings.purpose: the chroma both ends fade to

steps.fallback: the designed value of the step, so an unset accent leaves the theme exactly as drawn
